Subject: Intro + proposed kickoff slots for HorizonBio inference pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday. Based on what you shared about the internal data-privacy checks and your engineering sprint windows, I pulled together a short kickoff plan and two proposed demo slots (30–45 min):

- Wed Nov 10, 10:00–10:45 PT — focused on latency/cost profile for your batch inference use case
- Fri Nov 12, 09:00–09:45 PT — deeper look at Dedicated vs. Hosted options and rollout guardrails

Attached: initial-demo-agenda.md and a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MVP scope). If neither works, tell me what your calendar looks like after Nov 20 and we can rebook.

If Nov 10 or 12 works, I’ll reserve the slot and invite our Solution Engineer (Rishi) and your security contact as needed.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Logan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@horizonbio.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed kickoff slots for HorizonBio inference pilot

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 10:12 AM Elena Ruiz <elena@horizonbio.com> wrote:

Hi Logan — thanks for the plan and options. I’m sorry to say leadership just shifted priorities for the next two quarters: an accelerated regulatory submission has pulled most of our engineering and DS capacity into the compliance track.

We need to deprioritize the LLM/inference pilot for now. Can we pause the kickoff and revisit in Q2 2027? I don’t want to lose momentum entirely — can you keep the MAP and notes on file and ping us in late January to reconnect?

If you want to capture any quick data for your records (expected value, potential ROI, estimated seats) I can share a placeholder contact for procurement but there’s no active budget this quarter.

Best,
Elena
Director of Data Platforms, HorizonBio

Team —

Per Elena’s note, HorizonBio is pulling engineering into a regulatory push and wants to push the pilot to Q2 2027. Recommended next steps:

- Mark deal HB-2026-1142 as "deprioritized — nurture" in HubSpot and set a 2027-01-20 task to re-engage.
- Upload the MAP + agenda to the HorizonBio folder and tag Elena + procurement placeholder. Drive link: https://drive.company/horizonbio/kickoff-board
- Rishi: keep the demo materials lean (20–25 slides + 10-min live) so we can re-run the kickoff quickly.
- Neha: think about a low-effort nurture play (quarterly product brief + ROI snapshot) to keep them warm without heavy SE time.

If anyone prefers a short call with Elena to confirm the timeline, we can do a 15-min check-in next week — otherwise I’ll action the HubSpot changes.

— Marissa
